text:
Noah: quick thread  we still have time to tweak registration fields: thinking 3 variants for lead capture. want opinions.
Li: what are the variants?
Noah: A: minimal (email + company), B: interest areas (dedicated/private/hosted) + email, C: qualification (title, company size, interest areas). C hurts conversion but sales-ready.
Sofia: recommend A for top funnel promos, B on targeted enterprise outreach, C for inbound partner invites.
Carter: agree. also add a checkbox for "share pilot interest" to help route Dedicated leads.
Sonia: marketing ops note: we need utm params and a hidden field for trial-cta variant so we can A/B test follow-up sequences.
Noah: good point. set utm_campaign=webinar-apr and utm_content=ctaA/ctaB.
Li: for the webinar itself: we should include an accessibility checklist. captioning, slide ALT text, and a transcript for on-demand. who owns captions?
Sofia: we can outsource live captions to CaptionCorp, add cost to event line item. I'll own transcript publishing.
Carter: demo plan: show routing policies -> routing fallback -> Dedicated trial CTA. prefer recorded core + one live prompt. we should pre-seed cache to show performance delta.
Sonia: post-webinar nurture flows: variant A (econ-first) gets benchmark whitepaper, variant B (demo-first) gets small demo clip + invite to trial. Sales follow-up window = 48h.
rehearsal-bot: Rehearsal slots: Fri 10:00, Mon 16:00, Mon 18:00. RSVP here to lock.
Noah: content owners: Sofia will finalize abstracts, Carter will prep demo script, Li will request captions & accessibility notes, Sonia will wire tracking and nurture flows.
Sofia: abstract draft in thread: "Scaling inference: measurable tactics for latency, cost, and reliability." feedback?
Li: add 'real-world routes & fallback patterns' to make it less generic.
Sofia: updated: "Scaling inference: real-world routing, fallbacks, and benchmarks that save latency and cost."
Carter: demo ops checklist (paste):
```
- Use recorded demo video as fallback; play if live calls exceed threshold
- Pre-run cache prime script: /demo/prime.sh with 5 sample prefixes
- Start live prompt queue at T+18m (after benchmark slides)
- Tag @eng-oncall at T-5m; pinned rollback command: `/run rollback-demo-state`
- Stage network throttle test at T-5m (simulate 150rps burst for 20s)
```
Sonia: landing page CTA copy options: [Try Redwood Dedicated] vs [See cost & latency wins]  we'll A/B test. Also add a short customer quote on the page.
Noah: decision: registration variant B for partner-targeted emails, A for paid socials. A/B test CTAs. run final sign-off Thursday EOD.
Li: I'll schedule captions and request live caption budget.
Sofia: I'll post final abstract + slides to the drive by Thu 15:00.
Carter: I'll want a 30m dry run with slides + demo on Mon 16:00. adding to calendar.
Sonia: I'll configure tracking and create nurture playbook template, will share by Fri.
Noah: great. small ask: capture one-minute highlight clip during rehearsal for paid promos. anyone object?
Sofia: good idea. no objections.
Noah: thanks team. RSVP to rehearsal-bot for the slot you can make. :rocket:
